svg.title: MicMatrix full-color 8x8 LED gallery
svg.desc: Exact pixel artwork and two single-color variants on simulated dark circuit boards. LED glow is illustrative, not a brightness or thermal measurement.

g.text: Shared device artwork. New-install master 9%; maximum 10%. Preview glow is illustrative.
Large boards: full color. Small boards beneath: red / cyan single-color alternatives.
